info.title: JobHunt OS API
info.description:
Backend for JobHunt OS. Single-tenant.

**Two invariants the UI must respect:**
1. Every job carries `gaps` — JD requirements the candidate does *not* have. Always render them. Never let the UI imply the candidate has a gap technology.
2. Nothing in this API sends anything to another human. Outbound actions (Phase 4) will be draft-and-approve only.

post.summary: Add a company to the registry (idempotent on ats + token)

delete.summary: Remove a company from the registry

post.summary: Identify the ATS and board token behind a careers URL
post.description: Paste any job or careers URL. Returns the ATS type and the board token needed to poll its public API. This is the fastest way to grow the registry.

post.summary: Check which registry entries actually return jobs
post.description: Polls each board once and reports working / empty / failed. Run this after bulk-adding companies to prune bad tokens.

get.description: The approval-inbox feed. Filters compose: `?tier=1,2&status=to_apply&excludeDisqualified=true&sortBy=score`. Every item carries `gaps` — the JD requirements the candidate does not have. Render them; never hide them.

get.summary: Get one job, including the full description text

patch.summary: Move a job through the pipeline

post.description: Used by the approval inbox to clear a batch of decisions in one call.

post.summary: Ingest raw jobs from Chrome Extension or external scraper
post.description: Used by the Manifest V3 Chrome extension to ingest live LinkedIn / Naukri postings directly into the scoring pipeline.

post.summary: Poll every enabled board, dedupe, score and persist
post.description: Synchronous today — it returns when the run completes. Boards are polled with bounded concurrency and a politeness delay. Pass `dryRun: true` to see what would land without writing.

get.summary: One run, with its full stats payload
The effective scoring profile, plus whatever the UI has overridden
get.description: `effective` is what the scorer actually uses: the code default merged with `overrides`. `gaps` lists technologies the candidate does not have — the scorer can never count them as a match.

put.description: Partial by design — omitted fields fall through to the code default. `skills` merges rather than replaces, so you can nudge one weight. Call POST /profile/rescore afterwards to apply it to stored jobs.

delete.summary: Drop all overrides and fall back to the code default

post.summary: Re-score every stored job against the current profile
post.description: Scoring is a pure function of (job, profile, now), so this needs no network calls. Run it after any profile change.

get.description: One call for the console header: registry size, job counts by tier/status/source, and the last ingest.
Every state change, newest first. Phase 3+ attaches a screenshot path to browser actions.

get.summary: List email communications and auto-classified messages
get.description: Filter by category (interview_invite, assessment_link, application_ack, rejection, recruiter_outreach), actionRequired, or query.

patch.summary: Update message action status or linked job

post.summary: Synchronize emails from Gmail API and auto-classify
Generate an AI-powered truthful draft reply to an email

get.summary: Inbox summary statistics and actionable counts

Search and ingest live Naukri jobs into the unified scoring pipeline
Search and ingest live Indeed jobs into the unified scoring pipeline
Test authentication and connectivity for job boards and external services
